bullets.title: Helping Half-Tulpa
bullets.short: Will absorb <color=#FFD780FF>Half-Tulpas</color> that emerge during the challenge at intervals to <color=#FFD780FF>enhance itself</color>. Use attacks or Elemental Reactions to destroy Half-Tulpas in time or <color=#FFD780FF>Freeze</color> them to interrupt this absorption.
bullets.detail: <color=#FFD780FF>1 Half-Tulpa</color> will emerge during the challenge at intervals. After some time, the Hydro Tulpa will absorb Half-Tulpas to <color=#FFD780FF>enhance itself</color>: It will grow larger, its ATK will increase, and it will launch more dangerous attacks.\nUse attacks or Elemental Reactions to destroy Half-Tulpas in time or <color=#FFD780FF>Freeze</color> them to interrupt this absorption.

bullets.title: Torrential Flurry
bullets.short: Affected by the Ley Line disturbance, the Hydro Tulpa <color=#FFD780FF>will deploy a Shield</color> at intervals. Deal as much DMG to the Shield as possible and destroy it. If not, the Hydro Tulpa will unleash Torrential Flurry after a short time, <color=#FFD780FF>which will immediately defeat your current active character</color>.
bullets.detail: Affected by the Ley Line disturbance, the Hydro Tulpa will deploy a Shield during the challenge and enter a charging state as it prepares to launch Torrential Flurry. If it is successfully unleashed, <color=#FFD780FF>your current active character will be immediately defeated</color>.\nWhen the Hydro Tulpa deploys its Shield, all party members' Elemental Skill and Burst CDs will be reset, while their Elemental Energy, Fighting Spirit, and Serpent's Subtlety will be restored. Breaking the Shield before the Hydro Tulpa can charge up will interrupt Torrential Flurry.

bullets.title: Dual Pyroclast
bullets.short: Has two forms. Its initial form possesses <color=#FFD780FF>higher All RES</color>. After it takes a certain number of <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG</color> instances, it will enter its second form, in which <color=#FFD780FF>all RES apart from Pyro RES is greatly decreased</color>. After it goes on to take a certain number of additional <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG</color> instances, it will take immense DMG and be immobilized. This will also cause its <color=#FFD780FF>All RES to be further decreased</color>.
bullets.detail: Starts in the Geohuman form, which possesses <color=#FFD780FF>higher All Elemental and Physical RES</color>. After it takes a certain number of <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG</color> instances, it will completely enter its Molten Dragon form, in which <color=#FFD780FF>All Elemental and Physical RES apart from Pyro RES is greatly decreased</color>. After it goes on to take <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG</color>, it will progressively take additional DMG. If it takes a certain number of additional <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro DMG</color> instances while in Molten Dragon form, it will enter Overburn, falling down and becoming immobilized. This will also cause its <color=#FFD780FF>All Elemental and Physical RES to be further decreased</color>. After being immobilized for a time, it will return to Geohuman form.

bullets.short: For a while after the battle begins, the enemy will grant itself a Void Ward. You need to quickly destroy the Ward by using <color=#FFD780FF>a certain number of Elemental attacks</color>, which will cause it to become disoriented. <color=#FFD780FF>Nightsoul-aligned Elemental attacks</color> will be more effective at breaking the Ward. If you fail to destroy the Ward within the given time, the enemy will unleash a powerful, large-area strike.
bullets.detail: It can warp itself and transform into a formidable foe to attack.

bullets.title: Tenebrous Mimesis
bullets.short: Affected by the Ley Line disturbance, the Tenebrous Papilla will remain protected by a Void Ward throughout the battle. You must quickly break the Ward by using <color=#FFD780FF>a certain number of Elemental attacks</color>. Once the Ward is broken, the enemy will suffer a high amount of DMG based on the DMG absorbed by the Ward and will then enter an extended state of disarray. <color=#FFD780FF>Nightsoul-aligned Elemental attacks</color> will have greater Ward-breaking efficiency. They will also further increase the damage the enemy takes when the Ward is broken.
bullets.detail: It can warp itself and transform into a formidable foe to attack.

bullets.title: Attrition Assault
bullets.short: Affected by the Ley Line disturbance, should you fail to destroy the Void Ward within the given time, the enemy will unleash "Hatefully Beseech the Dark": after a brief delay, it will release a massive AoE strike that will <color=#FFD780FF>instantly knock out your active character</color>. If you break the Void Ward before this strike, you can prevent it from being unleashed.
bullets.detail: Some attacks will inflict the stackable "Attrition" state, which will cause your own active party member to lose HP after a certain amount of time passes.

bullets.title: Shadow Void Aegis
bullets.detail: Affected by the Ley Line disturbance, the Tenebrous Papilla will deploy a Void Ward while initiating attacks. Perform <color=#FFD780FF>a certain number of Elemental attacks</color> to break the Ward. Once the Void Ward is broken, the Tenebrous Papilla will receive a single instance of immense DMG based on the DMG absorbed by the Ward and enter a weakened state for an extended period of time. <color=#FFD780FF>Nightsoul-aligned Elemental attacks</color> are more effective at breaking the Ward and will increase the DMG dealt when the Ward is broken. After being in the weakened state for a while, the Tenebrous Papilla will attempt to re-deploy its Void Ward.

bullets.title: Hatefully Beseech the Dark
bullets.detail: Affected by the Ley Line disturbance, if the Void Ward remains unbroken for too long, the Tenebrous Papilla will initiate Hatefully Beseech the Dark: Enters a charging state, which, if the Void Ward continues to remain unbroken, will conclude with the Tenebrous Papilla unleashing a Wrathful Dark Bombardment, <color=#FFD780FF>immediately defeating your current active character</color>.

bullets.title: Thunderthorn Ward
bullets.short: After taking <color=#FFD780FF>a certain number of attacks</color>, it will deploy a "Thunderthorn Ward": Attacks against it will be reflected onto nearby characters. The Ward can be broken by using Elemental Reactions to <color=#FFD780FF>drain the Ward of Electro</color>.
bullets.detail: After taking <color=#FFD780FF>a certain number of attacks</color>, it will deploy a "Thunderthorn Ward": While the Ward is active, DMG will be reflected to nearby characters when it is attacked. The Ward can be broken by using Elemental Reactions to <color=#FFD780FF>drain the Ward of Electro</color>.

bullets.title: Thunderous Attrition
bullets.short: Affected by the Ley Line disturbance, the deployment progress of the "Thunderthorn Ward" will increase more rapidly, but it will also gradually recede over time. Meanwhile, the Electro contained within the "Thunderthorn Ward" will be significantly boosted.

In addition, the Elemental requirements for breaking the Thunderthorn Ward are greatly increased.

bullets.title: Fast Frequency-Hopping System
bullets.short: Due to the effects of the Ley Line disturbance, <color=#FFD780FF>more instances of Electro-Charged or Lunar-Charged DMG</color> are needed to disrupt the stamping devices. Alternatively, <color=#FFD780FF>deal more damage</color> to these devices for the same effect. <color=#FFD780FF>Electro-Charged or Lunar-Charged DMG</color> causes damage to the stamping devices more effectively. The damage caused by the stamping devices to the Knuckle Duckle increases based on <color=#FFD780FF>the total damage</color> taken by the stamping devices. In particular, any Electro-Charged DMG, Lunar-Charged DMG, and Electro DMG receive a higher scaling bonus.

bullets.title: Radiant Cocoon
bullets.short: When battle begins, the Nemesis's Geo RES increases, and they also apply Radiant Cocoon to characters. Characters afflicted by Radiant Cocoon <color=#FFD780FF>deal less DMG and receive less healing</color>. Afflicted characters break free from the cocoon when <color=#FFD780FF>their HP is restored to full through healing</color>. Once any character in the party breaks free, the Nemesis loses the Geo RES granted by Radiant Cocoon.
bullets.detail: After battle begins, the Nemesis harnesses Geo to apply Radiant Cocoon to characters and increase its own Geo RES. Characters afflicted by Radiant Cocoon <color=#FFD780FF>deal less DMG and receive less healing</color>. <color=#FFD780FF>When a character's HP is restored to full through healing</color>, they break free from the cocoon and gain the Disentangled effect, which boosts their abilities for a short time. Once any character in the party successfully breaks free, the Nemesis loses the Geo RES granted by Radiant Cocoon.

bullets.short: During battle, the Nemesis leaves a Moonstone Anchor in its place before leaping to higher ground to prepare an attack. Some time later, it unleashes a large and powerful AoE strike. bullets.title: Supreme Overseer
bullets.short: During combat, the Open-Eyed will enter the monitoring state: For a set duration, it tracks the number of times it takes <color=#FFD780FF>Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo</color> damage. When the number of hits from any one element reaches 3, it will exit this state and <color=#FFD780FF>record that element as a monitored target</color>.
bullets.detail: During combat, the Open-Eyed will enter the "Supreme Overseer" state. While in this state, it tracks the number of times it takes <color=#FFD780FF>Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo</color> damage. When the number of hits from any one element reaches 3, it will exit this state and <color=#FFD780FF>record that element as a monitored target</color>. If no element is successfully monitored, the record will remain empty, and it will instead deal a single instance of Geo DMG. After the first monitoring state ends, the enemy will re-enter this state again after a set interval. During the second monitoring phase, elements that have already been recorded will require a significantly higher number of hits to be monitored again.

bullets.title: Phenomena's Delirium
bullets.short: After the first monitoring state ends, the enemy will re-enter this state after a set interval. During the second monitoring phase, elements that have already been recorded will require a greater number of hits to be monitored again.
bullets.detail: After completing two rounds of Elemental Monitoring, the Open-Eyed will take to the air and begin preparing "Phenomena's Delirium." It will release the previously recorded elements and summon two corresponding Active Elemental Stars. If no elements were recorded, it will instead summon Inert Elemental Stars with <color=#FFD780FF>high resistance to all elements and Physical DMG</color>. When an Active Elemental Star is destroyed, it deals a large amount of damage to the enemy based on the recorded element. If an Inert Elemental Star is destroyed, it instead deals Geo DMG to the enemy. <color=#D3BC8EFF>Destroy all Elemental Stars</color> to interrupt the preparation of "Phenomena's Delirium." If both stars are not destroyed within the time limit, they will explode, dealing massive AoE damage.
